versos.grego: Καί τινες κατελθόντες ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἐδίδασκον τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὅτι Ἐὰν μὴ περιτμηθῆτε τῷ ἔθει τῷ Μωϋσέως, οὐ δύνασθε σωθῆναι.

controles.web: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”
controles.kjv: And certain men which came down from Judea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
controles.livre: E alguns que tinham descido da Judeia ensinavam aos irmãos, dizendo : Se vós não vos circuncidardes conforme o costume de Moisés, não podeis ser salvos.

versos.grego: γενομένης δὲ στάσεως καὶ ζητήσεως οὐκ ὀλίγης τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ τῷ Βαρνάβᾳ πρὸς αὐτοὺς, ἔταξαν ἀναβαίνειν Παῦλον καὶ Βαρνάβαν καί τινας ἄλλους ἐξ αὐτῶν πρὸς τοὺς ἀποστόλους καὶ πρεσβυτέρους εἰς Ἱερουσαλὴμ περὶ τοῦ ζητήματος τούτου.

controles.web: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul and Barnabas, and some others of them, to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.
controles.kjv: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
controles.livre: Então, havendo não pequena resistência e confronto de Paulo e Barnabé contra eles, ordenaram que Paulo, Barnabé e alguns outros deles subissem aos apóstolos e aos anciãos a Jerusalém sobre esta questão.

versos.grego: Οἱ μὲν οὖν προπεμφθέντες ὑπὸ τῆς ἐκκλησίας διήρχοντο τήν τε Φοινίκην καὶ Σαμάριαν ἐκδιηγούμενοι τὴν ἐπιστροφὴν τῶν ἐθνῶν, καὶ ἐποίουν χαρὰν μεγάλην πᾶσιν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς.

controles.web: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.
controles.kjv: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
controles.livre: Então sendo eles preparados para a viagem e despedidos pela igreja, passaram pela Fenícia e Samaria, contando sobre a conversão dos gentios; e davam grande alegria a todos os irmãos.

versos.grego: παραγενόμενοι δὲ εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα παρεδέχθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς ἐκκλησίας καὶ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων, ἀνήγγειλάν τε ὅσα ὁ Θεὸς ἐποίησεν μετ’ αὐτῶν.

controles.web: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported all things that God had done with them.
controles.kjv: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
controles.livre: E tendo chegado a Jerusalém, eles foram recebidos pela igreja, e pelos apóstolos e anciãos; e lhes anunciaram quão grandes coisas Deus tinha feito com eles;

versos.grego: Ἐξανέστησαν δέ τινες τῶν ἀπὸ τῆς αἱρέσεως τῶν Φαρισαίων πεπιστευκότες, λέγοντες ὅτι δεῖ περιτέμνειν αὐτοὺς παραγγέλλειν τε τηρεῖν τὸν νόμον Μωϋσέως.

controles.web: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”
controles.kjv: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
controles.livre: Mas que alguns do grupo dos fariseus que tinham crido, levantaram-se, dizendo que era necessário circuncidá-los, e mandar -lhes que guardem a Lei de Moisés.

versos.grego: Συνήχθησάν τε οἱ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἰδεῖν περὶ τοῦ λόγου τούτου.

controles.web: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.
controles.kjv: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
controles.livre: E os apóstolos e anciãos se reuniram para dar atenção a este assunto.

versos.grego: Πολλῆς δὲ ζητήσεως γενομένης ἀναστὰς Πέτρος εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί, ὑμεῖς ἐπίστασθε ὅτι ἀφ’ ἡμερῶν ἀρχαίων ἐν ὑμῖν ἐξελέξατο ὁ Θεὸς διὰ τοῦ στόματός μου ἀκοῦσαι τὰ ἔθνη τὸν λόγον τοῦ εὐαγγελίου καὶ πιστεῦσαι.

controles.web: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you, that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News, and believe.
controles.kjv: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
controles.livre: E havendo muita discussão, Pedro se levantou, e lhes disse: Homens irmãos, vós sabeis que há muito tempo Deus meu escolheu entre nós, para que por minha boca os gentios ouvissem a palavra do Evangelho, e cressem.

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ καρδιογνώστης Θεὸς ἐμαρτύρησεν αὐτοῖς δοὺς τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον καθὼς καὶ ἡμῖν,

controles.web: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.
controles.kjv: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;
controles.livre: E Deus, que conhece os corações, deu-lhes testemunho, dando-lhes o Espírito Santo, assim como também a nós.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐθὲν διέκρινεν μεταξὺ ἡμῶν τε καὶ αὐτῶν, τῇ πίστει καθαρίσας τὰς καρδίας αὐτῶν.

controles.web: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.
controles.kjv: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
controles.livre: E nenhuma diferença fez entre nós e eles, purificando seus corações pela fé.

versos.grego: νῦν οὖν τί πειράζετε τὸν Θεόν, ἐπιθεῖναι ζυγὸν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον τῶν μαθητῶν, ὃν οὔτε οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν οὔτε ἡμεῖς ἰσχύσαμεν βαστάσαι;

controles.web: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
controles.kjv: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
controles.livre: Então agora, por que tentais a Deus, pondo um jugo sobre o pescoço dos discípulos; que nem nossos pais, nem nós podemos levar?

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ διὰ τῆς χάριτος τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ πιστεύομεν σωθῆναι καθ’ ὃν τρόπον κἀκεῖνοι.

controles.web: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus,  just as they are.”
controles.kjv: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
controles.livre: Mas cremos que, pela graça do Senhor Jesus Cristo, nós somos salvos, assim como também eles.

versos.grego: Ἐσίγησεν δὲ πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος, καὶ ἤκουον Βαρνάβα καὶ Παύλου ἐξηγουμένων ὅσα ἐποίησεν ὁ Θεὸς σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν δι’ αὐτῶν.

controles.web: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.
controles.kjv: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
controles.livre: E toda a multidão se calou; e ouviram a Barnabé e a Paulo, que contavam quão grandes sinais e milagres Deus tinha feito por meio deles entre os gentios.

versos.grego: Μετὰ δὲ τὸ σιγῆσαι αὐτοὺς ἀπεκρίθη Ἰάκωβος λέγων Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί, ἀκούσατέ μου.

controles.web: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.
controles.kjv: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:
controles.livre: E tendo estes se calado, Tiago respondeu, dizendo: Homens irmãos, ouvi-me:

versos.grego: Συμεὼν ἐξηγήσατο καθὼς πρῶτον ὁ Θεὸς ἐπεσκέψατο λαβεῖν ἐξ ἐθνῶν λαὸν τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations, to take out of them a people for his name.
controles.kjv: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
controles.livre: Simão informou como primeiro Deus visitou aos gentios, para tomar deles um povo para seu nome.

versos.grego: καὶ τούτῳ συμφωνοῦσιν οἱ λόγοι τῶν προφητῶν, καθὼς γέγραπται

controles.web: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,
controles.kjv: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
controles.livre: E com isso concordam as palavras dos profetas, como está escrito:

versos.grego: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἀναστρέψω καὶ ἀνοικοδομήσω τὴν σκηνὴν Δαυεὶδ τὴν πεπτωκυῖαν, καὶ τὰ κατεστραμμένα αὐτῆς ἀνοικοδομήσω καὶ ἀνορθώσω αὐτήν,

controles.web: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up,
controles.kjv: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
controles.livre: Depois disto eu voltarei, e reconstruirei o tabernáculo de Davi, que caído está; e reconstruirei de suas ruínas, e voltarei a levantá-lo;

versos.grego: ὅπως ἂν ἐκζητήσωσιν οἱ κατάλοιποι τῶν ἀνθρώπων τὸν Κύριον, καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἐφ’ οὓς ἐπικέκληται τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐπ’ αὐτούς, λέγει Κύριος ποιῶν ταῦτα

controles.web: That the rest of men may seek after the Lord; all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.
controles.kjv: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
controles.livre: Para que o resto da humanidade busque ao Senhor, e todos os gentios  sobre os quais meu nome é invocado, diz o Senhor, que faz todas estas coisas,

versos.grego: γνωστὰ ἀπ’ αἰῶνος.

controles.web: All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.’
controles.kjv: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.
controles.livre: conhecidas desde a antiguidade.

versos.grego: διὸ ἐγὼ κρίνω μὴ παρενοχλεῖν τοῖς ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐπιστρέφουσιν ἐπὶ τὸν Θεόν,

controles.web: “Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,
controles.kjv: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
controles.livre: Portanto eu julgo que aqueles que dos gentios se convertem a Deus não devem ser perturbados.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ἐπιστεῖλαι αὐτοῖς τοῦ ἀπέχεσθαι τῶν ἀλισγημάτων τῶν εἰδώλων καὶ τῆς πορνείας καὶ πνικτοῦ καὶ τοῦ αἵματος.

controles.web: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.
controles.kjv: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.
controles.livre: Mas que lhes escrevamos para que se abstenham das contaminações dos ídolos, e do pecado sexual, e da carne sufocada, e do sangue.

versos.grego: Μωϋσῆς γὰρ ἐκ γενεῶν ἀρχαίων κατὰ πόλιν τοὺς κηρύσσοντας αὐτὸν ἔχει ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς κατὰ πᾶν σάββατον ἀναγινωσκόμενος.

controles.web: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”
controles.kjv: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
controles.livre: Porque Moisés, desde as gerações antigas, tem em cada cidade quem o pregue nas sinagogas, sendo lido todo sábado.

versos.grego: Τότε ἔδοξε τοῖς ἀποστόλοις καὶ τοῖς πρεσβυτέροις σὺν ὅλῃ τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ ἐκλεξαμένους ἄνδρας ἐξ αὐτῶν πέμψαι εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν σὺν τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ Βαρνάβᾳ, Ἰούδαν τὸν καλούμενον Βαρσαββᾶν καὶ Σιλᾶν, ἄνδρας ἡγουμένους ἐν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς,

controles.web: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.
controles.kjv: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
controles.livre: Então pareceu bem aos apóstolos, e aos anciãos, com toda a igreja, eleger deles alguns homens, para serem enviados com Paulo e Barnabé a Antioquia: Judas, que tinha por sobrenome Barsabás; e a Silas, homens líderes entre os irmãos.

versos.grego: γράψαντες διὰ χειρὸς αὐτῶν Οἱ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἀδελφοὶ τοῖς κατὰ τὴν Ἀντιόχειαν καὶ Συρίαν καὶ Κιλικίαν ἀδελφοῖς τοῖς ἐξ ἐθνῶν χαίρειν.

controles.web: They wrote these things by their hand:   “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.
controles.kjv: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:
controles.livre: E escreveram por meio deles o seguinte: Os apóstolos e os anciãos, e os irmãos – para os irmãos dentre os gentios, que estão em Antioquia, Síria e Cilícia; saudações.

versos.grego: Ἐπειδὴ ἠκούσαμεν ὅτι τινὲς ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐτάραξαν ὑμᾶς λόγοις ἀνασκευάζοντες τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν, οἷς οὐ διεστειλάμεθα,

controles.web: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;
controles.kjv: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
controles.livre: Dado que ouvimos que alguns dos que saíram de nós vos perturbaram com palavras, e causaram incômodo a vossas almas,  aos quais não mandamos;

versos.grego: ἔδοξεν ἡμῖν γενομένοις ὁμοθυμαδὸν, ἐκλεξαμένους ἄνδρας πέμψαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς σὺν τοῖς ἀγαπητοῖς ἡμῶν Βαρνάβᾳ καὶ Παύλῳ,

controles.web: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
controles.kjv: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
controles.livre: Pareceu-nos bem, reunidos em concordância, escolher alguns homens, e enviá-los até vós, com nossos amados Barnabé e Paulo.

versos.grego: ἀνθρώποις παραδεδωκόσι τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν ὑπὲρ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Homens que têm arriscado suas vidas pelo nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: ἀπεστάλκαμεν οὖν Ἰούδαν καὶ Σιλᾶν, καὶ αὐτοὺς διὰ λόγου ἀπαγγέλλοντας τὰ αὐτά.

controles.web: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.
controles.kjv: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
controles.livre: Então enviamos a Judas e a Silas, os quais vos dirão as mesmas coisas pessoalmente.

versos.grego: ἔδοξεν γὰρ τῷ Πνεύματι τῷ Ἁγίῳ καὶ ἡμῖν μηδὲν πλέον ἐπιτίθεσθαι ὑμῖν βάρος πλὴν τούτων τῶν ἐπάναγκες,

controles.web: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:
controles.kjv: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
controles.livre: Porque pareceu bem ao Espírito Santo e a nós, de nenhuma carga a mais vos impor, a não ser estas coisas necessárias:

versos.grego: ἀπέχεσθαι εἰδωλοθύτων καὶ αἵματος καὶ πνικτῶν καὶ πορνείας· ἐξ ὧν διατηροῦντες ἑαυτοὺς εὖ πράξετε. Ἔρρωσθε.

controles.web: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”
controles.kjv: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.
controles.livre: Que vos abstenhais das coisas sacrificadas aos ídolos, do sangue, da carne sufocada, e do pecado sexual; das quais, se vos guardardes, fareis bem. Que o bem vos suceda.

versos.grego: Οἱ μὲν οὖν ἀπολυθέντες κατῆλθον εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν, καὶ συναγαγόντες τὸ πλῆθος ἐπέδωκαν τὴν ἐπιστολήν.

controles.web: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.
controles.kjv: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
controles.livre: Sendo, pois, eles despedidos, vieram a Antioquia, e reunindo a multidão, entregaram a carta.

versos.grego: ἀναγνόντες δὲ ἐχάρησαν ἐπὶ τῇ παρακλήσει.

controles.web: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.
controles.kjv: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
controles.livre: E ao lerem, alegraram-se pela consolação.

versos.grego: Ἰούδας τε καὶ Σιλᾶς, καὶ αὐτοὶ προφῆται ὄντες, διὰ λόγου πολλοῦ παρεκάλεσαν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ ἐπεστήριξαν·

controles.web: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words, and strengthened them.
controles.kjv: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
controles.livre: E então Judas e Silas, sendo também profetas, com muitas palavras exortaram e firmaram aos irmãos.

versos.grego: ποιήσαντες δὲ χρόνον ἀπελύθησαν μετ’ εἰρήνης ἀπὸ τῶν ἀδελφῶν πρὸς τοὺς ἀποστείλαντας αὐτούς.

controles.web: After they had spent some time there, they were sent back with greetings from the brothers to the apostles.
controles.kjv: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
controles.livre: E ficando ali por algum tempo, permitiram que voltassem em paz dos irmãos para os apóstolos.

versos.grego: Παῦλος δὲ καὶ Βαρνάβας διέτριβον ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ, διδάσκοντες καὶ εὐαγγελιζόμενοι μετὰ καὶ ἑτέρων πολλῶν τὸν λόγον τοῦ Κυρίου.

controles.web: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
controles.kjv: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
controles.livre: E Paulo e Barnabé ficaram em Antioquia, ensinando e evangelizando, com também muitos outros, a palavra do Senhor.

versos.grego: Μετὰ δέ τινας ἡμέρας εἶπεν πρὸς Βαρνάβαν Παῦλος Ἐπιστρέψαντες δὴ ἐπισκεψώμεθα τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς κατὰ πόλιν πᾶσαν ἐν αἷς κατηγγείλαμεν τὸν λόγον τοῦ Κυρίου, πῶς ἔχουσιν.

controles.web: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”
controles.kjv: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.
controles.livre: E depois de alguns dias, Paulo disse a Barnabé: Voltemos a visitar a nossos irmãos em cada cidade onde tenhamos anunciado a palavra do Senhor, para ver como estão.

versos.grego: Βαρνάβας δὲ ἐβούλετο συνπαραλαβεῖν καὶ τὸν Ἰωάνην τὸν καλούμενον Μάρκον·

controles.web: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.
controles.kjv: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
controles.livre: E Barnabé aconselhou para que tomassem consigo a João, chamado Marcos.

versos.grego: Παῦλος δὲ ἠξίου, τὸν ἀποστάντα ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Παμφυλίας καὶ μὴ συνελθόντα αὐτοῖς εἰς τὸ ἔργον, μὴ συνπαραλαμβάνειν τοῦτον.

controles.web: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.
controles.kjv: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
controles.livre: Mas Paulo achou adequado que não tomassem consigo a aquele que desde a Panfília tinha se separado deles, e não tinha ido com eles para aquela obra.

versos.grego: ἐγένετο δὲ παροξυσμός, ὥστε ἀποχωρισθῆναι αὐτοὺς ἀπ’ ἀλλήλων, τόν τε Βαρνάβαν παραλαβόντα τὸν Μάρκον ἐκπλεῦσαι εἰς Κύπρον.

controles.web: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him, and sailed away to Cyprus,
controles.kjv: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
controles.livre: Houve então entre eles tal discórdia, que eles se separaram um do outro; e Barnabé, tomando consigo a Marcos, navegou para o Chipre.

versos.grego: Παῦλος δὲ ἐπιλεξάμενος Σιλᾶν ἐξῆλθεν, παραδοθεὶς τῇ χάριτι τοῦ Κυρίου ὑπὸ τῶν ἀδελφῶν·

controles.web: but Paul chose Silas, and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.
controles.kjv: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
controles.livre: Mas Paulo, escolhendo a Silas, partiu-se, enviado pelos irmãos para a graça de Deus.

versos.grego: διήρχετο δὲ τὴν Συρίαν καὶ Κιλικίαν ἐπιστηρίζων τὰς ἐκκλησίας.

controles.web: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.
controles.kjv: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
controles.livre: E ele passou pela Síria e Cilícia, firmando as igrejas.
